name: Artificer
role: Field preparation, invention, equipment utility, and adaptable tactical support

classAbility.name: Field Formulae
effect: Choose one of the three Artificer Subclasses, then learn two Formulas from that Subclass's five listed Formulas.
Designate one known Formula as your Field Specialty: it is always prepared and fills the Artificer's Subclass Signature slot.
The other is known but must occupy one of the Artificer's four optional prepared Command slots to be used in battle.
Whenever Commands are prepared outside combat, a different known Formula from the Artificer's own Subclass may be designated as Field Specialty.
Formula Commands use their own CP costs, activation timing, and occasional Craft/Mysticism Skill Checks.
Formula-based Assault Attacks replace the Artificer's ordinary Assault action.
New Formulas and improvements are gained through Artificer Talents (see talents/artificer_talents.json).

startingEquipment.note: Artificers may choose a Pistol, Dagger, or Shortsword when selecting starting weapons; they may equip one melee weapon and one ranged weapon normally, paying each selected weapon's listed Equipment Points. They may acquire other equipment later under the ordinary equipment rules. There are no free weapons or extra Point charges for starting Formulas.
notes: Artificers may also use their known Formula Attacks as their selected Assault action, paying CP and satisfying the corresponding Formula's preparation requirements.
Formula Attack profiles appear in the subclass tables below for convenience and are defined in 18_artificer_formulas.md.

subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.description: Alchemists create field remedies, smoke, corrosive mixtures, and volatile thrown flasks. Choose two of their five Formulas at creation.

formulas.name: Quick Tonic
formulas.summary: Mind + Craft; next friendly Move bonus scales with successes, max +4".

formulas.name: Restorative Draught
formulas.summary: Mind + Craft; Heal up to 2 on one surviving Model.

formulas.name: Smoke Vial
formulas.summary: Create a 2"-radius smoke area granting Cover 1.

formulas.name: Corrosive Flask
formulas.summary: Physical Attack; on Hit, suppress Tough before Armor and through the Round.

subclasses.name: Machinist
subclasses.description: Machinists specialize in deployable devices, positioning, and targeting. Choose two of their five Formulas at creation.

formulas.name: Proximity Charge
formulas.summary: Trap marker: 2 automatic Physical Hits, Armor/Ward, no Evade.

formulas.name: Snare Wire
formulas.summary: Agility + Craft; trap inflicts Slow based on successes.

formulas.name: Spotter Lens
formulas.summary: Reduce target's effective Cover X by 1 against next allied ranged Attack.

formulas.name: Winch Line
formulas.summary: Body + Craft; reposition an allied Unit according to successes.

subclasses.name: Runesmith
subclasses.description: Runesmiths temporarily inscribe equipment to create elemental attacks and defensive safeguards. Choose two of their five Formulas at creation.

formulas.name: Ember Rune
formulas.summary: Next friendly Physical Weapon Attack gains Fire and Accurate 1.

formulas.name: Frost Rune
formulas.summary: Next friendly Physical Weapon Attack gains Frost; unsaved Damage inflicts Slow 1.

formulas.name: Hunter's Sigil
formulas.summary: Mind + Mysticism; next friendly Weapon Attack gains Anti-[type] X based on successes.

formulas.name: Warding Etching
formulas.summary: Grant Ward 6+ against Magic for the Round.

notes: A runed Physical Weapon Attack remains Physical, even when it receives Fire or Frost. Elemental attributes may be carried by Physical or Magic Attacks; they do not change defenses unless a specific rule states otherwise.
